post.description:
V2 canonical runtime:

    Policy
    -> Memory
    -> Knowledge
    -> Hermes(Language -> Problem -> Reasoning)
    -> Ollama generation
    -> Trust
    -> Audit

V1 engines remain untouched. Hermes is injected as the V2 runtime
boundary rather than duplicating Language/Problem/Reasoning engines.
